Who it is for

Who it is for and how I work.

What exactly I build for different kinds of work, what working together looks like and what I have built so far.

Clinics and practices

Today
Bookings in a notebook, records in folders, balances “in your head”.
With a system
A shared calendar, client records, payment per treatment and reminders for the team.

Salons and studios

Today
Clients call, text and walk in, and the schedule is kept by hand.
With a system
Booking without double slots, client history and a daily schedule for everyone.

Repair shops and workshops

Today
Nobody is sure what came in, what is waiting for parts and what is done.
With a system
Job tickets with status, parts and a message to the client when it is ready.

Schools, courses and coaches

Today
Groups, attendance and fees spread over several sheets.
With a system
Groups and sessions, attendance and a clear view of who has paid.

Offices and agencies

Today
Clients, tasks and deadlines scattered across email and chats.
With a system
One view of clients and tasks, with deadlines and owners.

Associations and clubs

Today
One person keeps the member list and payments in a private sheet.
With a system
Members, payments and events in one place the whole board can use.

Sales and stock

Today
Orders arrive from several places and stock is checked by hand.
With a system
Orders in one place, stock levels and an overview of deliveries.

Freelancers and small teams

Today
You cannot see where the time goes or which project pays off.
With a system
Projects, time tracking and a per-client overview, like in BARVIS Focus.

Do not see your kind of work here? Describe it in a few sentences and we will see what makes sense.

How we work.

From the first call to support, in five steps. You always know what is being done and what comes next.

  1. 01Call

    30 minutes by video or phone. We talk about how you work today, what slows you down and what should be easier.

  2. 02Quote and plan

    You get a written quote: what gets built, in what order, by when and for how much. You pay nothing before we agree.

  3. 03Built in rounds

    The work is split into short rounds. After each one you see a working version, try it and say what should change.

  4. 04Launch

    Your existing data is moved over, we check everything is in place and the team is trained, so you use it from day one.

  5. 05Support

    After launch I am there for fixes, improvements and new features, at a pace that suits you.
